title: Cheyenne language
description: Algonquian language spoken in the United States
extract: Cheyenne is an indigenous language of North America, spoken mainly in present-day Montana and Oklahoma, in the United States. It is a member of the Algonquian language family, and named for the Cheyenne peoples, who are native to the Great Plains of the United States.
